item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; moisture introduced at manufacture

rater_note: Part 573: motor vibration transmitted into the Gen 4 inverter causes fretting of internal pads/contacts on the gate-driver board over time, signal interruptions and switching-module failure; 55 failures analysed across the fleet; fleet-health monitoring proxy improved by higher sampling rate. rater_note: Part 573 + chronology: incorrectly installed loopback CAN harness connector chafes on frame rail and shorts, interrupting CAN and propulsion; found by inspection. Defective part is a signal harness/connector.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; striker alignment

item3_signals_and_rate: diagnostic request traffic to the BMS at bus rate and BMS memory/reset state over the seconds before the reset

item3_signals_and_rate: isolation-monitor reading and fault classification at the shutdown, ~10 Hz

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; weldment dimension

item3_signals_and_rate: HVAC operating state, cabin humidity and temperature over hours of the specific operating scenario, ~0.1-1 Hz
rater_note: Part 573: condensation on the AC distribution housing in a specific operating scenario seeps onto the airbag control unit and corrodes its connector over time; parts analysis, environmental tests reproduced the scenario. Needs operating-scenario history.

item3_signals_and_rate: module/cell voltages for self-discharge detection over days to months while parked and charging, ~0.01-1 Hz
rater_note: Part 573: HV battery modules may thermally propagate; supplier teardown found shifted electrodes in some modules, a second production issue, and incidents with no clear root cause; self-discharge-detection software would have warned months ahead in three incidents. Defective part is the cell modules.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; mislabelled part
rater_note: Part 573: supplier mislabelled rear suspension modules after a process change; plant identified wrong modules.

item3_signals_and_rate: isolation-monitor reading and fault classification at the shutdown, ~10 Hz
rater_note: Part 573: same mechanism as the companion campaign: vehicle control software misclassified a real temporary loss of HV isolation and shut down HV while driving; analysis and testing. Not software-only (real isolation event); vehicle/powertrain control software flagged out of scope.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; weld
rater_note: Part 573: incorrectly welded part in the pretensioner from improper friction-welder maintenance at the supplier.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful (pyrotechnic event is milliseconds)
rater_note: Part 573: supplier process variation in the sealing piston allows gas blow-by after pretensioning, impairing belt locking; conformity, component and sled testing.

item3_signals_and_rate: HV shutdown / isolation fault snapshot; cause is bracket fatigue
rater_note: Part 573: bracket supporting fuse box and main disconnect switch fatigues from switch mass and vibration; switch terminals short and shut down HV; inspection and analysis. Defective part is a bracket.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; weld
rater_note: Part 573 + DIR: improper pedestal-to-base-plate weld at seat supplier; returned pedestal inspected.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; glass edge defect
rater_note: Part 573: roof hatch tempered glass may contain an edge defect leading to failure; cause and chronology NR. The defective feature is named but not why.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; U-bolt torque
rater_note: Part 573: substitute spring U-bolts not properly torqued; returned parts and cycle testing.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; wrong part
rater_note: Part 573 + chronology: seat belts for another market (no ALR) installed; found in plant inspection.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; design compliance
rater_note: Part 573: aluminium rear impact guards may not meet FMVSS 223 performance; cause TBD.

item3_signals_and_rate: HV fuse current pulse history (peak and I2t per acceleration event) accumulated over many rides, ~100 Hz current with per-ride summaries
rater_note: Part 573: repeated rapid acceleration events degrade the HV fuse until it opens; warranty/field review. Cumulative degradation over many events.

item3_signals_and_rate: contactor coil current/resistance snapshot at the opening
rater_note: Part 573: pack contactors with a solenoid from one supplier can open suddenly due to poor coil termination connection; high coil resistance found; failure analysis of recovered contactors. Static manufacturing defect.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; extrusion defect
rater_note: Part 573: center-lock wheel nuts crack from lack of material fusion in a Tier-2 extrusion process; returned parts and supplier review.

item3_signals_and_rate: pack/inverter current vs broadcast current limit and contactor state at ~100 Hz over the seconds of the over-limit (regen) event
rater_note: Part 573: inverter software may not obey the broadcast current limit, so the isolation contactors open and the battery shuts down; earlier generations linked to regen at high SoC. The over-limit current is a hardware electrical event, so not software-only.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; latch design
rater_note: Part 573: tailgate latch pawl perpendicular to catch is susceptible to walkout under dynamic loading; design analysis and testing; warranty repairs.

item3_signals_and_rate: string-open / fuse-blown warning code and module temperature snapshot; static weld defect
rater_note: Part 573: inadequate weld penetration on a busbar inside the battery module separates over time, arcs, heats and drives a neighbouring cell into thermal runaway; BMS software did not lock out the pack; module autopsy. Defective part is inside the battery module; flagged out of scope.

rating_documents: RCLRPT-24V700-1828.PDF; RMISC-24V700-8676.pdf; RCLRPT-24V700-7150.PDF; RCLRPT-24V700-2521.pdf; RCLRPT-24V700-8941.pdf; RCLRPT-24V700-8406.pdf; RMISC-24V700-2120.pdf
item3_signals_and_rate: cell voltages and SoC fluctuation over a full drive/monitoring cycle and cell temperatures during Level 3 quick charging, ~1 Hz
rater_note: Part 573 + Nissan DIR (amendment 3): excessive lithium deposits in cells raise resistance and cause SoC fluctuation; Level 3 quick charging then heats the battery rapidly; root cause of the deposits still under investigation; cell disassembly and pack analysis; records showed SoC fluctuation before events; remedy software detects fluctuation over a monitoring cycle. Defective part is the cells.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; masking left in place
rater_note: Part 573: paint masking left between wheel and hub compresses and loosens lug nuts; inspection of claim vehicles.

item3_signals_and_rate: cell voltages and SoC fluctuation over a full drive/monitoring cycle and cell temperatures during Level 3 quick charging, ~1 Hz
rater_note: Part 573 + Nissan DIR (amendment 2): expansion of the companion LEAF campaign to later model years; excessive lithium deposits in cells raise resistance, cause SoC fluctuation, and rapid heating during Level 3 quick charging; root cause of deposits still under investigation; battery testing of incident packs. Defective part is the cells.

item3_signals_and_rate: cell voltages and temperatures, SoC dwell at high charge and charging-current ripple over charge sessions and days, ~1-10 Hz plus ripple at kHz
rater_note: Part 573: same mechanism as the earlier EQB campaign: supplier early-production variations plus external factors (charging current ripple, mechanical damage) leave cells insufficiently robust at high SoC; no specific root cause; returned batteries and cells analysed; remedy BMS software. Defective part is the cells.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; trim retention
rater_note: Part 573: rear quarter window trim not properly secured at the supplier; warranty claims and supplier build-record analysis. Cause field blank but the defect states the supplier assembly fault.

item3_signals_and_rate: contactor current, temperature and contact resistance over DC fast-charge sessions and repeated wide-open-pedal events and accumulated wear, ~10 Hz
rater_note: Part 573: scope amendment of the BEC contactor campaign: main contactor design and part-to-part variation not robust to heat from repeated WOT and DC fast-charge events; heat and accumulated wear; warranty claims. Cause accumulates over sessions.

item3_signals_and_rate: cell voltages and temperatures during and after charging and self-discharge over hours, ~0.1-1 Hz
rater_note: Part 573: cell modules may overheat during or shortly after charging; supplier names two possible root causes (particle contamination or separator damage) causing an internal short; no Bentley field occurrences. Defective part is the cells.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; heat treatment
rater_note: Part 573: control-arm pivot bolt may not have been fully hardened by the supplier; supplier production records.

item3_signals_and_rate: inter-module message exchange and HCP reset reason at the reset, CAN at bus rate
rater_note: Part 573: incomplete communication between the telematics box module and the hybrid control processor (after an over-the-air software release) makes the HCP reset and lose motive power; surge of complaints and field reports. No electrical event; no time scale stated. Defective part is telematics module software (out of scope under my convention).

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; assembly workmanship
rater_note: Part 573: body joint strength failures (protective film left in adhesive joints, missing fastener) by an untrained assembler; compliance tests.

item3_signals_and_rate: cell voltages, SoC and commanded regen current at ~10-100 Hz over the regen event
rater_note: Part 573: vehicle software commanded more regenerative braking than the battery could sustain; BMS measured a cell voltage above its limit and shut down as designed (prompted by a related campaign). Cell over-voltage is a hardware electrical state, so not software-only. Regen duration not stated.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; fairing attachment
rater_note: Part 573: roof fairing may detach in transit; cause still under investigation.

item3_signals_and_rate: inverter fault code and phase-current/DC-link snapshot at the torque loss
rater_note: Part 573: a fault in the drive inverter may stop torque; cause NR; field-data analysis found an increased failure rate in inverters fitted with a particular MOSFET population. The defective component population is named but no mechanism.

item3_signals_and_rate: EPCU fault DTC snapshot; coolant ingress is a static sealing defect
rater_note: Part 573 + Attachment A: EPCU DC-DC converter housing insufficiently sealed (inadequate steam cleaning in manufacture), internal coolant leak contaminates the EPCU controller; field-information analysis. Static manufacturing defect.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; crimp strength
rater_note: Part 573: improperly crimped pretensioner anchors with low tensile strength; supplier lot acceptance test.

item3_signals_and_rate: motor phase currents at >= 100 kHz over the millisecond short and the inverter over-current detection flag
rater_note: Part 573 + Nissan DIR (image-only, read as page images): conductive fibrous shavings from the drive-motor slip ring momentarily short the slip rings; the inverter detects the momentary over-current and cuts torque; DTC showed a short in the motor, inspection found shavings. Remedy is inverter fail-safe software, but the defective part is the motor slip ring, so flagged out of scope.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; alignment ring angle
rater_note: Part 573: alignment ring installed at the wrong angle during wheel alignment at the plant; routine inspection.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; U-bolt axial force
rater_note: Part 573 + chronology: misalignment of parts and torque variation reduce U-bolt axial force; inspections and bench test reproduced the dent and force loss.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; weld and tooling
rater_note: Part 573: seat bracket improperly welded and slider parts out of tolerance from tool wear; returned part and supplier inspection.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; wrong labels
rater_note: Part 573: sun visors with non-US airbag warning labels fitted; plant audit.

item3_signals_and_rate: junction-box joint resistance/temperature and isolation DTC snapshot; static design gap
rater_note: Part 573: design drawing error leaves a gap between busbar and connector in the motor sub-junction box, the bolt loosens, resistance and heat rise and DTCs cut current; found in durability testing and teardown. Static design defect.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; non-functioning disconnect is a static part condition
rater_note: Part 573: supplier traceability gap on a new line shipped non-functioning pyrotechnic battery disconnects; found in validation test. Static part defect.

item3_signals_and_rate: inter-inverter CAN traffic and buffer occupancy, missing frames and timeout timer at bus rate over seconds before the blocking fault
rater_note: Part 573: cumulative CAN traffic from one inverter overflows the buffer, frames are lost, firmware is intolerant and the message times out, opening the traction contactor; reproduced; first-phase message-profile fix. No hardware electrical event.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; latch material (ambient temperature in a snapshot)
rater_note: Part 573 + Attachment A: trunk latch pawl material contracts at high ambient temperature and can be damaged on manual release; field trend and material durability testing.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; emblem resin durability
rater_note: Part 573: driver airbag cover emblem posts may crack over time from Tier-2 production variation and detach on deployment. Attached DIRs are image-only and were not read as text; the Part 573 text was sufficient.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; latch design change
rater_note: Part 573 (pass-through of equipment recall): supplier handle redesign created a weak attachment point on the entry door latch.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; fastener torque
rater_note: Part 573: steer-axle spring hanger fasteners may be under-torqued (manufacturing defect); plant quality control.

item3_signals_and_rate: BMS self-diagnosis fault entry and inverter internal measurement plausibility flag at the reset/deactivation
rater_note: Part 573: BMS self-diagnosis software too sensitive causes unnecessary resets; inverter software misevaluates internal measurements and may deactivate the inverter; decision based on field fault entries. No hardware electrical event.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; geometric interference
rater_note: Part 573: rear emergency door cannot open fully with certain seats installed near the back wall (design/configuration); fixture check.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; repair bonding
rater_note: Part 573 + chronology + PE21-001 resumes: front roof panel bonded with wrong adhesive or pre-treatment during prior workshop repair; adhesion deteriorates over time; test setups recreated repair scenarios and returned panels analysed.

item3_signals_and_rate: LIN6 communication-loss DTC and BMS limp-mode flag snapshot
rater_note: Part 573: a failure in the cabin electric water pump causes LIN6 bus communication loss, which puts the BMS in an 8.5 kW limp mode; supplier root cause on returned pumps. Defective part is a water pump.

item3_signals_and_rate: ICCU HV input transients at >= 10 kHz and ICCU/coolant temperature cycling over charge and drive cycles at ~1 Hz
rater_note: Part 573 + chronology + PE23-012 resumes: ICCU damaged over time by transient high voltage and thermal cycling; collected ICCUs showed damage after thermal cycling and voltage peaks; over-current damaging LDC FETs noted at opening. Mixed transient and cumulative thermal cause.

item3_signals_and_rate: HV arc/fault DTC snapshot; static missing nut
rater_note: Part 573 + chronology: junction-box busbar retention nut removed during rework and not re-verified; arcing at the joint triggers DTCs disabling HV; returned parts evaluated. Static assembly defect.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; cable design
rater_note: Part 573: seat-belt steel cable can fatigue from repeated bending over the seat structure during entry; returned parts and supplier investigation. Design weakness under normal use.

item3_signals_and_rate: none useful; missing weld
rater_note: Part 573: rear spoiler upper surface welded incorrectly or not at all at the supplier; inspection of the incident part.

item3_signals_and_rate: contactor state, coil current and pack temperature (-40 C) snapshot at the opening
rater_note: Part 573 (pass-through of the battery supplier's equipment recall): HV contactors with a manufacturing defect in the coil terminal can open under load at -40 C. Static part defect plus an ambient condition visible in a snapshot.
